description: Na₃SbS₃ crystallizes in the cubic P2_13 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six equivalent S atoms. There are three shorter (2.85 Å) and three longer (3.07 Å) Na-S bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six equivalent S atoms. There are three shorter (2.86 Å) and three longer (3.04 Å) Na-S bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six equivalent S atoms. There are three shorter (3.02 Å) and three longer (3.13 Å) Na-S bond lengths. Sb is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three equivalent S atoms. All Sb-S bond lengths are 2.44 Å. S is bonded to six Na and one Sb atom to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing SNa₆Sb pentagonal bipyramids.
